caseStudy.problem: A simulation-first Python memory architecture with episodic recall, state machines and scenario-based tests.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: The Python CLI runs deterministic scenarios through memory, recall and state-machine components. YAML configuration separates scenario inputs from the runtime; an optional Streamlit dashboard inspects results.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Simulation-first research prototype. Synthetic results do not establish physical-world recognition accuracy or a deployed autonomous system.
